SELECT status, fulfilment_type, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT web_order_id) AS d, MIN(order_ts_utc), MAX(order_ts_utc)
FROM fact_web_order
WHERE CAST(order_ts_utc AS DATE) = DATE '2025-11-28'
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY ALL

calls.statement:
WITH o AS (
  SELECT * FROM fact_web_order
  WHERE CAST(order_ts_utc AS DATE) = DATE '2025-11-28' AND status <> 'cancelled'
),
t AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT f.receipt_id
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  WHERE p.category = 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS orders, COUNT(DISTINCT o.web_order_id) AS distinct_orders,
  SUM(CASE WHEN o.web_order_id IN (SELECT receipt_id FROM t) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS test_orders,
  SUM(CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fact_sales_line f WHERE f.receipt_id=o.web_order_id) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS no_lines
FROM o

SELECT COUNT(*) AS helsinki_day_orders
FROM fact_web_order
WHERE status <> 'cancelled'
  AND CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) = DATE '2025-11-28'
